hero.name: Dr Yang Bong
hero.role: Senior Lecturer, School of Business and Law
hero.bio: I am a multidisciplinary researcher working where digital technologies, participatory research and business meet. My work spans digital inclusion, rural and Indigenous entrepreneurship, subsistence marketplaces, platform economies and AI for sustainable development, and it combines community co-design with machine learning and data analytics.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: I am a Senior Lecturer in the School of Business and Law at Birmingham Newman University, and an Honorary Associate Researcher at N/Lab, Nottingham University Business School. I completed my PhD in Digital Economy at the University of Nottingham, with the Horizon Centre for Doctoral Training.

I am Sarawakian, and much of my research begins there, in community-engaged fieldwork and co-design with rural and Indigenous micro-entrepreneurs. Alongside this I use machine learning and data analytics to study platform economies. I am a founding member and coordinator of the [Asia-Europe for AI (AE4AI) Network](https://www.asiaeurope4ai.org/), where I coordinate the AI for Sustainable Development working group. Before academia, I spent eight years in international marketing and business development.

research.heading: Research
research.intro: My current research follows three connected themes.

themes.title: Digital inclusion and subsistence marketplaces
themes.description: AI and digital inclusion with underserved communities, digital appropriation in subsistence marketplaces, and digital entrepreneurship ecosystems.

themes.title: Machine learning for social science
themes.description: Machine learning and data analytics for social-science research, including innovation in agriculture research and household energy.

themes.title: AI for sustainable development
themes.description: The role of universities and local institutions in socially grounded innovation.

publications.heading: Publications
publications.intro: A full list, newest first. My [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ZRQISOwAAAAJ) has citation details.

items.title: Horizon CDT impact project
items.text: I secured and delivered a Horizon CDT impact project, co-designing digital marketing and market-access activities with rural and Indigenous micro-entrepreneurs in Malaysia. Working with the Lun Bawang community of Long Semadoh in rural Lawas, Sarawak, and with the creative agency The Culture Capital, the project grew from digital marketing training into a village-wide branding campaign shaped by community leaders and entrepreneurs.

link.label: Read about the project at Horizon CDT

items.title: Asia-Europe for AI (AE4AI) Network
items.text: I am a founding member and coordinator of the AE4AI Network, and I coordinate its AI for Sustainable Development working group.

items.title: ASEF white paper for universities
items.text: I am first author of the White Paper for Universities on Navigating Artificial Intelligence Innovation Ecosystems in AI for Sustainable Development, produced through the 6th ASEF Higher Education Innovation Laboratory.

project.heading: Long Semadoh, Sarawak
project.summary: In the Lun Bawang highlands of Lawas, I worked with village leaders, local micro-entrepreneurs and The Culture Capital to co-design a village-wide brand, so that the community could tell its own story to visitors and buyers.
project.quoteNote: The campaign’s tagline invites visitors who truly want to come, while keeping numbers manageable for the village.
outputs: Instagram and Facebook accounts designed for the community to run
Product packaging with a QR code linking to those accounts
Videos, photographs and community interviews for future marketing
A branding and digital marketing workshop for ten micro-entrepreneurs, taught in Malay

timeline.text: Project begins, funded by a Horizon CDT impact grant.
Guest talk at Caraga State University, Philippines.
Fieldwork and co-design workshop in Long Semadoh.
Guest lecture at the University of Technology Sarawak, with village visits.
Virtual guest lecture for Universiti Teknologi Brunei.
Public engagement talk in Nottingham through the Code-RED project.

map.alt: Map of Borneo and the southern Philippines marking Long Semadoh in Sarawak, where the fieldwork took place, and the universities in Sibu, Brunei and Butuan where I gave guest lectures.

teaching.heading: Teaching
teaching.intro: I have taught in higher education since 2023, at undergraduate and postgraduate levels.

items.text: I lead and deliver undergraduate teaching across marketing, digital marketing and entrepreneurship.
I taught machine learning, predictive analytics and customer insights in the Marketing, Tourism and Analytics department, with guest lectures in the School of Computer Science.
I have given guest lectures at universities in Malaysia, Brunei and the Philippines, and taught digital marketing for rural communities.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.text: I welcome conversations about research collaboration and community partnerships.
